extracted.name: Yogurt-dressed pasta salad
extracted.description: Make our faff-free traybake kebab and use the leftovers as the base to make this pasta salad, packed with sundried tomatoes and olives, and full of flavour
ingredient_lines: 50g sundried tomatoes roughly chopped, plus 2 tbsp of the oil
150g leftover traybake lamb kebab roughly chopped (see step 1)
150g Greek-style natural yogurt or leftover yogurt sauce (see lamb kebab recipe below)
3 sprigs mint leaves picked and finely chopped
instruction_lines: Drizzle the oil from the sundried tomatoes into a pan over a medium-low heat and stir in the garlic and chilli flakes. Cook for 1-2 mins then mix in the lamb, coating it in the oil. Fry for 4-5 mins to warm through.

Meanwhile, cook the pasta following pack instructions, then drain and rinse in some cold water. Set aside to cool slightly. Mix the yogurt, molasses, lemon zest, mint and cumin then season to taste. Stir in the sundried tomatoes, olives and the leftover salad. Divide the pasta between your plates, top with the yogurt and the lamb, then drizzle over the oil from the pan to serve.
